about.heading: About Vitadiet
about.description: Vitadiet  is a Saudi company specialized in medical distribution. It operates exclusively on a B2B basis and provides exclusive agencies for high-quality European dietary supplements certified by local and international regulatory bodies, primarily the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA). The company does not sell directly to consumers. It deals only with pharmacies, authorized distributors, and suppliers within the Kingdom.
about.responsibility: For Vitadiet , importing supplements is not only a commercial activity. It is a scientific and ethical responsibility built on clinical evidence, safety review, transparent documentation, quality, and purity.
